mentions.name: Housetrained
mentions.description: A self-hosted puppy potty tracker forked from the open source Baby Buddy project. It logs potty breaks to help house train a new puppy and runs locally for privacy.
mentions.problem: Needed a way to track a puppy's potty breaks to help with house training.
mentions.source_excerpt: We just got a puppy, and needed a way to track potties to help us with house training. So, with AI/Claude's help, I found a similar open source package (Baby Buddy), forked it, and very quickly made it my own. Self-hosted, local for privacy reasons.
